steps.goal: Find affected services, severity inputs and recent changes.

steps.goal: Test hypotheses for each suspect within the tool budget.

steps.goal: Confirm the expected effect is sustained, else roll back.

- Affected service: checkout (alert is on checkout service error rate)
- Error rate: 0.25 (25%) on checkout service
- P95 latency for checkout is normal (5 seconds for accounting and fraud-detection, checkout latency not elevated)
- CPU and memory metrics for checkout are normal

internal.title: Incident Summary: Checkout Service Errors Due to Payment Failures
internal.body:
At 10:32 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the checkout service. Investigation identified the root cause as payment failures caused by invalid tokens in the payment service, which led to knock-on errors in checkout. The paymentFailure flag was disabled at 10:52 UTC after approval, resulting in recovery and normalization of error rates. No evidence supported session corruption or cart service issues. The incident was resolved promptly after disabling the paymentFailure flag.

Timeline:
- 10:32:47: Alert received for checkout service error rate spike.
- 10:52:28: Diagnosis confirmed payment failure as root cause.
- 10:52:29: PaymentFailure flag disabled after approval.
- 10:52:29: Recovery verified with normalized error rates.

Actions taken:
- Disabled paymentFailure flag to stop error injection.

Lessons learned and recommendations are included in the postmortem section.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment issues
external.body: Between 10:32 and 10:52 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. The issue was identified and resolved by disabling a problematic payment validation mechanism. Normal service resumed shortly after. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

output.summary: Checkout service experienced elevated error rates due to payment service failures involving invalid tokens, resolved by disabling the paymentFailure flag.
output.impact: Customers experienced checkout failures during the incident window due to payment processing errors.
output.root_cause: Payment service failures caused by invalid tokens led to checkout errors. Disabling the paymentFailure flag resolved the issue.
output.resolution: The paymentFailure flag was disabled after diagnosis and approval, resulting in recovery and normalization of error rates in the checkout service.

lessons.lesson: Implement more robust validation and monitoring of payment tokens to prevent invalid token errors from impacting checkout.
lessons.applies_when: When the paymentFailure flag is enabled and payment token errors are detected.

lessons.lesson: Ensure rapid diagnosis and flag management procedures are in place to quickly mitigate knock-on errors from dependent services.
lessons.applies_when: When checkout service error rates spike due to downstream service failures.

action_items: Review and improve payment token validation logic.
Enhance monitoring and alerting for payment token errors.
Train on rapid flag management and incident response for dependent service failures.
